custom_instructions: Prioritize rapid triage, recommend accurate specialists among General Physician, Cardiologist, Dermatologist, Neurologist, Psychologist, Nutritionist, Orthopedic, and Pediatrician, and always provide safe clinical questions for consultation.

training_examples.symptoms: Severe sudden chest tightness, shortness of breath, left arm pain
training_examples.advice: Seek immediate emergency medical attention. Avoid physical exertion.

training_examples.symptoms: Itchy red rash with dry flaking patches across the face and elbows
training_examples.advice: Keep skin hydrated with mild emollients and avoid harsh soaps until examined.

training_examples.symptoms: Chronic recurring throbbing headache on one side of head with sensitivity to light and nausea
training_examples.advice: Rest in a quiet, dark room, stay hydrated, and maintain a symptom trigger diary.

training_examples.symptoms: Persistent low mood, excessive worry, sleep disruption, and anxiety for over 3 months
training_examples.advice: Consider cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) and structured lifestyle routines.

training_examples.symptoms: Unexplained weight gain, chronic lethargy, dietary digestive discomfort, and high cholesterol
training_examples.advice: Adopt a balanced whole-food diet with appropriate macro nutrient distribution.

training_examples.symptoms: Persistent knee joint pain, swelling, and cracking sound when climbing stairs
training_examples.advice: Avoid high-impact activities, apply cold/warm compress, and consult an orthopedic specialist.

training_examples.symptoms: High fever, barking cough, and loss of appetite in a 4-year-old child
training_examples.advice: Ensure adequate fluid intake and consult a pediatrician immediately for child evaluation.

training_examples.symptoms: Mild fever, runny nose, sore throat, and body ache for 2 days
training_examples.advice: Get plenty of rest, drink warm fluids, and monitor body temperature.
